{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lodi''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] that was native to [[Solibus IV]]. They disappeared [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], by which time it was rumored that the secrets of the species were stored in the [[Shu-Wang Prism]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|259|Lodi}}</ref>
